faqItems.question: What can BLACK VISION source?
faqItems.answer: Cars, fashion, watches, home and interior products, business equipment, construction materials, electronics, and custom requests outside these categories. If it can be sourced, tell us what you need.

faqItems.question: Where do you operate?
faqItems.answer: We operate on the ground in China and Dubai, coordinating with clients internationally and delivery worldwide.

faqItems.question: Is my request handled by a real person?
faqItems.answer: Yes, always. A member of our team reads and responds to every request personally — there's no chatbot and no automated system between you and us.

faqItems.question: Do you work with individuals?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Private clients submit a request the same way businesses do, and it is handled directly by our team.

faqItems.question: Do you work with businesses?
faqItems.answer: Yes. We support companies sourcing equipment, machinery, OEM production, private label and bulk orders.

faqItems.question: Can you source custom products?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Custom and hard-to-find requests are a core part of what we do — submit a request with as much detail as you can.

faqItems.question: How does pricing work?
faqItems.answer: Pricing depends on the product, supplier and quantity. Once we source and verify what you're looking for, you receive a clear quotation before anything moves forward.

faqItems.question: How does payment work?
faqItems.answer: Payment terms are confirmed with you directly once a quotation is agreed, before we proceed with procurement.

faqItems.question: How does delivery work?
faqItems.answer: We coordinate logistics and delivery to your destination once a purchase is confirmed, and keep you updated along the way.

faqItems.question: Can you source in bulk?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Bulk and business orders are handled through the same request process, with quantity and destination specified upfront.

faqItems.question: How do I submit a request?
faqItems.answer: Use the request form to tell us what you need. We review it and get back to you.

about.metaDescription: BLACK VISION was built around one idea: finding the right product should not require knowing the right people.
about.heroSub: BLACK VISION was built around one idea: finding the right product should not require knowing the right people.
about.ideaTitle: A private access office, not a marketplace.
about.ideaSub: Clients don't come to browse. They come to say what they need — and we find it, verify it, and bring it to them.
about.p1: We work between China and Dubai — sourcing products, suppliers and opportunities for private clients and businesses around the world.
about.p2: That means cars, fashion, watches, interiors, business equipment, construction materials and electronics — and anything else a client brings to us that falls outside those categories.
about.p3: We work with individuals sourcing a single piece, and with companies sourcing at scale. The process is the same either way: request, source, verify, quote, procure, deliver.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: When you submit a request or contact us, we collect the details you provide — such as your name, email or WhatsApp number, and the specifics of what you're looking for, including any file or link you choose to share.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: We use this information to review your request, source and verify what you're looking for, prepare a quotation, and communicate with you about your request.

sections.title: Sharing
sections.body: We share request details with suppliers or partners only as necessary to fulfil your request, and do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may ask us to access, correct or delete the information we hold about you at any time by contacting us directly.

terms.heroSub: Last updated — to be confirmed before launch.

sections.title: Our service
sections.body: BLACK VISION sources products, suppliers and opportunities on request. Submitting a request does not guarantee availability — we confirm what we can source and provide a quotation before anything proceeds.

sections.title: Quotations and payment
sections.body: Quotations are confirmed with you directly and are only valid for the period stated at the time. Payment terms are agreed before procurement begins.

sections.title: Delivery
sections.body: Delivery timelines depend on the product, supplier and destination, and are communicated once a purchase is confirmed.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
sections.body: BLACK VISION acts as a sourcing and procurement intermediary. We take reasonable care in verifying suppliers and products, but do not manufacture the goods we source.
